scientific_integrity: Reconstructs the map from geometric Picard classes, enumerates every even-signed Weyl action by exact integer Smith reduction; no independent verification claimed.
scientific_limitations: Conditional on the Weyl Frobenius class, not a realizability theorem for every finite field. Cokernels of formal label lattices, not Picard or Brauer torsion; possible unindexed prior incidence table remains a priority risk.
title: Integral Frobenius conic-support lattices for quartic del Pezzo surfaces
